title: 3.0 / Brand Elements
slide_intent: Treat color and typography as recurring identity cues so recognition extends beyond the logo.
strategic_value: Repeated type and color choices can make Spectrum’s separate messages feel related.
demonstration: A cyan section number leads a dark blue heading over a pale gray gradient. A short introduction links typography and color to the design attributes.
practical_value: Locate color and typography rules when reviewing identity cues beyond the logo.
